image_description: A close-up, top-down view of a brown butterfly resting on a textured, light-colored rocky surface. The butterfly has its wings spread open, revealing a dark brown coloration with distinct orange patches near the wing margins and several small black eyespots (ocelli). The body is dark, fuzzy, and segmented, positioned centrally between the wings. Two thin antennae extend from the head.
